name: side split squat
description: A wide side-to-side squat on one leg at a time. It builds the thighs and mobilises the hips.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Lower until your thigh is parallel.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.
